text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Kuh! I only managed to place...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
In PriFigh,
the princess always wins in the end, though...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to show everyone
just how strong and beautiful a princess can be!
choice_data_list: You were first place in princess-ness!
You were first in terms of being princess-like!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"However...
I can't afford to be satisfied just yet!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Because the princess I aspire to be never gives up and keeps running—
to seize her 'ideal'!"
choice_data_list: I see... Then let's keep running!
I see... Then let's keep on running!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
The path to becoming a true princess is not an easy one, is it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"With you saying such things by my side, I am sure we can...
No! We shall reach it without fail!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course!!
I cannot let it end like this!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A true princess!
Clings on no matter what, bite and bite!
I might as well tear them all to shreds~~~!!
choice_data_list: D-Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry!
I have a very strong jaw, you know!
